about_short_description.short_description: Bujeti is a web and mobile app for issuing smart physical and virtual corporate cards to make bank transfer payments.

product.name: Expense Management
product.description: A business expense platform for tracking transactions, enforcing spending policies, managing budgets, and processing employee reimbursements.

product.name: Corporate Cards
product.description: Physical and virtual corporate cards in Naira, USD, and other supported currencies, with configurable spending limits and controls for teams.

product.name: Payments Automation
product.description: A payment workflow for vendors, staff salaries, supplier invoices, and budget funding, using configurable approval rules and automated processing.

product.name: Bank Connect
product.description: A bank-account connectivity service that syncs multiple business accounts for centralised balance monitoring, transaction tracking, reporting, and payments.

product.name: Invoicing
product.description: A digital invoicing service for creating branded invoices, collecting payments, automating reminders, and tracking receivables in NGN or USD.

product.name: Tax Management
product.description: A tax-compliance tool for configuring taxes, applying them to transactions and invoices, separating funds into a tax vault, and exporting tax records.
